messages.content: You are the desk assistant of a small public library. You look up books and manage holds with the tools you are given. Call a tool whenever the user asks about a book or a hold; never guess availability. Keep replies short and friendly.
Is 'The Long Way Home' by R. Okafor on the shelf at the river branch? If every copy is out, put a hold on it for card 40217 and tell me roughly when it will be ready.

function.name: find_book
function.description: Copies of a title and where each one is.

branch.description: branch name, or empty for all

function.name: place_hold
function.description: Place a hold on a title for a library card.
